ORR_DESKTOP docs: GitHub publication + README/concept/roadmap + 100% pure-Rust (no external ffmpeg) architecture plan
body:
Documentation + planning band for ORR_DESKTOP (S:/rust/ORR_DESKTOP).

Goal 1 — GitHub publication docs:
- README.md (EN): what the app does, screenshots/GIF placeholder, build (windows-gnu toolchain), run, CLI usage.
- CONCEPT.md: vision, scope, non-goals.
- ROADMAP.md: phased plans (band list) for the rewrite.
- GitHub repo prep: platinoff/ORR_DESKTOP, .gitignore audit, CI sketch (fmt+clippy+test).

Goal 2 — 100% pure Rust architecture plan (hard requirement):
- The app must NOT shell out to side applications. ffmpeg.exe as an external process is banned in the target architecture.
- Document the migration path from current spawn-ffmpeg design to an all-Rust pipeline in the crate structure:
  capture (windows-rs / Windows.Graphics.Capture or GDI fallback) → frame pipeline → encode (pure-Rust encoder crates, e.g. rav1e/openh264 bindings evaluated) → mux (pure-Rust MP4 muxer crate).
- Each stage becomes its own module in src/ structure with trait boundaries so encoders are pluggable.

Deliverable: docs written in S:/rust/ORR_DESKTOP/docs/, one commit in the product repo at drain close. Drain discipline: S0 disk → HANDOFF → fmt → cargo test → one commit.

title: P1: pipeline scaffold — FrameSource/VideoEncoder/Muxer traits + pump, ffspawn legacy wrapper
body:
Band 1 of pure-Rust rewrite (docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 2 entry, docs/ARCHITECTURE_PURE_RUST.md steps 1).

Add src/pipeline.rs with traits FrameSource / VideoEncoder / Muxer + Frame/FrameSpec/Sample types and a run() pump (source→encoder→muxer, finish flush order). Add empty-but-real src/capture/, src/encode/, src/mux/ modules. Extract recorder arg-building into a testable build_args() and add capture/ffspawn.rs legacy wrapper (no behavior change — ffmpeg path stays default).

Acceptance: unit tests with counting fake source + passthrough encoder + memory muxer verify frame count, sample flow, finalize order; existing CLI behavior unchanged; cargo test green.

title: P2: native capture — GDI BitBlt FrameSource (crop parity with gdigrab)
body:
Band 2 (ROADMAP Phase 2, ARCHITECTURE step 2a): src/capture/gdi.rs — BitBlt-based FrameSource producing BGRA frames + pts.

Must match gdigrab crop math exactly: same offset_x/offset_y/video_size semantics as current cli-area, DPI-aware physical pixels, multi-monitor negative origins handled.

Acceptance: pixel-parity test vs ffmpeg gdigrab on a synthetic test pattern (same rect → same dimensions; sampled pixels equal within tolerance); fps pacing independent of GDI blocking.

title: P3: native capture — Windows.Graphics.Capture source (DPI, multi-monitor)
body:
Band 3 (ROADMAP Phase 2): src/capture/wgcap.rs — Windows.Graphics.Capture FrameSource via windows-rs (Direct3D11 texture → BGRA staging readback).

Handles: monitor enumeration with negative origins, per-monitor DPI, cursor drawing option, item creation on Windows 10 1903+ with GDI fallback when API absent.

Acceptance: fullscreen + region session produces correct-dimension frames at requested fps; falls back cleanly to gdi.rs on unsupported hosts; no leaked COM references across start/stop cycles (test loop x50).

title: P4: in-process SW encode (openh264) + MP4 muxer; default switches to native path
body:
Band 4 (ROADMAP Phase 3 core): in-process encode + mux.

src/encode/sw.rs — software H.264 encoder behind VideoEncoder trait using openh264 crate (bundled C via -sys, linked INTO our binary — no external process; rav1e swap evaluated later per ARCHITECTURE_PURE_RUST.md table). BGRA→YUV420 conversion in-house. Quality presets map from existing Quality enum (cq/bitrate semantics preserved as close as codec allows).
src/mux/mp4.rs — MP4 muxer via mp4-muxer crate behind Muxer trait (+faststart-equivalent: moov placement), exact duration on finish.

Acceptance: pipeline::run(gdi_source, sw_encoder, mp4_mux) writes a playable MP4 with zero external executables touched (assert no child processes spawned); ffprobe-free sanity checks in test (ftyp box present, duration == frames/fps ±1).

title: P5: remove ffspawn — zero external executables acceptance
body:
Band 5 (ROADMAP Phase 3 close): delete src/capture/ffspawn.rs and all std::process::Command usage from the record path; recorder.rs keeps only detect/probe for hardware discovery reporting.

Acceptance (clean machine): app records fullscreen + region with ffmpeg NOT installed / ORR_FFMPEG unset; grep proves no Command spawn in src/ except none; output MP4 passes box-walk test (ftyp+moov, duration exact); tray + CLI flows re-verified. This closes ROADMAP Phase 3.

title: P6: HW encoders in-process (NVENC/QSV/AMF via vendor APIs)
body:
Band 6 (ROADMAP Phase 3 stretch): hardware encoders in-process behind VideoEncoder trait — NVENC/QSV/AMF via vendor APIs with D3D11 frame interop (windows-rs). Reuse existing probe philosophy: runtime test-encode validation before selection, priority NVENC > QSV > AMF > SW preserved; Encoder::Auto unchanged UX.

Acceptance: on AMD iGPU host, AMF path produces valid MP4 at 1080p30 with GPU encode confirmed (no CPU-bound SW fallback in profile log); graceful fallback chain when driver rejects init mid-session.
